paragraphs.source_en: The ethnography however shows that the eland is not the principal food provider of the ! Kung who hunt a large variety of animals. The reason for the predominance of eland in the rock art is therefore more ideological than practical. Indeed, the chief personage of the San mythology, a divine creator of all things in the world, preferred the eland out of all the animals. Thus, the eland was considered by the San the supreme antelope with the most supernatural power (Lewis-Williams 1981). Also, at least one San community spoke of themselves as being "of the eland" (Vinicombe 1976) expressing thus their group identity.

paragraphs.source_en: Why did the San choose the eland and not another animal? When seeking for the answer Lewis-Williams asked a ! Kung woman why, at the girls' first menstruation, they perform the Eland Bull dance and not another antelope's dance. She answered that it was because the eland has much fat and the girl is also all fat and they are therefore the same (Lewis-Williams 1981). It was because of the animal's fat that it became privileged in the ideology. We can thus suppose that in the case of the Round Head mouflon and antelope it was because of some of their qualities that they became privileged; qualities that were important, unique or fundamental for the Early Holocene hunter-gatherers.

paragraphs.source_en: These qualities may also be related to the locality. If the Tassili Plateau, being the highest massif in the study area (dwelling of gods?) with the most spectacular rock formations, was indeed considered the most important area for the image-making, it was probably considered not only a special place but also a sacred one. In such a high altitude the most characteristic animals were certainly the mouflon and the antelope, which were able to survive there even during arid periods. The capacity of mouflon and antelope to survive in a harsh environment could have been noticed in the Late Pleistocene by human groups possibly frequenting the region before the climatic optimum in the 10th millennium BP.
